data.title: As each planning skill, STRATA_SKIP early evaluation + sub-agent env inheritance + fail-open

content.text: **What**: Each planning skill (brainstorm, preplanning, implementation-plan) checks strata.skip BEFORE any Strata Read or sub-agent dispatch. Sub-agents inherit STRATA_SKIP=true env var when set. STRATA_SKIP fail-open: when signal absent (A2 not yet merged or renamed), gating treats absence as STRATA_SKIP=false (proceed with detection). Missing/malformed facts files emit warning `[B] facts unavailable; running without Strata context` and fall back to non-Strata behavior — never block planning.
**Why**: Skip-signal must be honored uniformly across the three skills + sub-agents; fail-open prevents B from blocking workflows when prerequisites are absent.

- IN: Pre-Read strata.skip check in each of the three skills; STRATA_SKIP=true env var on sub-agent dispatches; fail-open warning + behavior on missing/malformed facts; fail-open treatment of absent strata.skip.
- When complete, strata.skip=true blocks ALL SDK Reads in each of the three skills ← Satisfies: SC2, behavioral guarantee fail-open-on-load
- When complete, sub-agents receive STRATA_SKIP=true env var when parent skill is skipping ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, absent strata.skip key is treated as false (fail-open; proceed with detection) ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, missing/malformed facts files emit the named warning and fall back to non-Strata behavior ← Satisfies: behavioral guarantee fail-open-on-load
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for each path
- [Reliability] Fail-open is the universal fallback — never block on B's machinery

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
